title: Preserve native long-double and binary128 representations
problem: Passing extended values through double loses range and precision before formatting.
design: Native 80-bit and 128-bit decomposition feeds the same exact decimal algorithm. Formatting does not require quadmath conversion.
tradeoffs: Layouts and availability are target dependent. Unsupported representations return a checked status.
source_changes: Test-only binary128 guard enables FMT_USE_FLOAT128 before the oracle include only when FFMT_HAS_FLOAT128 is true; unsupported compilers still compile the return77 branch. Formatter logic is unchanged.
